title: S4 dependency lens — input
description: Like slo, NOT cross-cutting -- a dependency edge is defined per outbound call site, not per point kind uniformly. points is filtered to http_client_call/queue_producer kinds by the caller.

points.description: surface_map.json points of kind http_client_call or queue_producer only -- each represents an outbound dependency edge.

context.description: context.yaml, if an interview has run -- the source of own_target: this lens does not invent an SLO target independently, it reads the calling journey's own workflow criticality (and, when available, an already-designed slo_spec's own objective.target for the same journey) rather than guessing.
